Subject: Request: Redwood demo next week

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the quick reply on the intro call yesterday. Anna (cc'd) and I would like a focused product demo that covers latency/cost controls and private deployment options.

Would Thursday, Mar 20 at 10:00 CET work for you? That's the slot that fits our internal calendar best. If that doesn't work, we can do Wed Mar 19 14:00 CET instead.

Subject: Re: Request: Redwood demo next week

Hi Samuel / Anna —

Thanks — both slots look good from our side. Quick note on clocks: the US switched to DST last weekend (Mar 9), while most of Europe doesn't change until Mar 30. That means for the next two weeks CET is one hour earlier relative to our Eastern time than it normally is. I want to avoid any 5:00am ET wake-ups for the team.

Two options:
- Keep Thu Mar 20 but move to 11:00 CET (so it's 07:00 ET for us) — still a bit early but doable for a short demo.
- Or move to Wed Mar 19 at 15:00 CET (11:00 ET) which is a nicer slot for our engineers.

I've tentatively created a calendar invite for Wed Mar 19 15:00 CET / 11:00 ET and attached a draft agenda and a mutual action plan. If you prefer Thu at the later CET time, we'll adjust.

Apologies for the extra coordination — wanted to surface the DST mismatch so there are no surprises on the day.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

- If the customer prefers Thu, moving to 11:00 CET is OK but that will be 07:00 ET for the US team; we'd keep the technical deep dive to 10 minutes and keep the Q&A focused.
